facts.Program: Legend Star Startup CEO Training Program
facts.Funding / Support: Free founder education; investment decisions are separate from the course.
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Startup founders or CEOs; interviews assess both the person and the business.
facts.Strong-to-Have: An existing company with management challenges, a technology background and clear development goals.
facts.Format: Free founder training and entrepreneur community.
facts.On-site / Attendance: Classes are mainly in Beijing, with some courses in other cities.
facts.Deadline / Next Intake: Cohort 19 closed June 26, 2026; cohort 20 applications are planned to open in May 2027.
facts.Application Materials: Online registration and interview; required materials depend on the current intake.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: High-growth technology startups; primarily at the Existing startup founders / CEOs stage.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Projects without venture-scale ambitions, founders unable to commit full-time, or teams seeking short-term exposure only.
facts.Notes: Operating since 2008, with 1,429 participants through the end of 2025. A founder development program rather than a typical equity accelerator.
